inputs.name: ReportRecordValidator.validate.record
inputs.description: One record supplied for validation. Its kind must be check, evidence, finding, coverage, acceptance, summary, or heartbeat, and its data object is checked according to that kind.

outputs.name: ReportRecordValidator.validate
outputs.description: The method has no result payload and returns undefined after the record passes validation.

errors.name: InvalidAcceptanceCriteriaError
errors.description: The acceptance record must contain at most 30 nonempty strings of up to 500 characters each.

errors.name: InvalidAudioDurationError
errors.description: A supplied audio duration must be finite and nonnegative.

errors.name: InvalidAudioTranscriptError
errors.description: A supplied audio transcript must be a string of at most 10,000 characters.

errors.name: InvalidEvidencePhaseError
errors.description: A supplied truthy phase must be before, after, or current.

errors.name: InvalidEvidenceStatusError
errors.description: A truthy evidence status must be one of running, passed, failed, blocked, skipped, not-proven, or interrupted.

errors.name: InvalidRecordStatusError
errors.description: A nonevidence item requires one of running, passed, failed, blocked, skipped, not-proven, or interrupted.

errors.name: InvalidReportOrAssetIdError
errors.description: The record ID must contain 1–100 ASCII letters, digits, underscores, or hyphens.

errors.name: MissingEvidencePathError
errors.description: An evidence record requires a nonempty path.

errors.name: MissingRecordDataError
errors.description: Record data must be a non-array object.

errors.name: MissingRecordTitleError
errors.description: The title of a check, finding, or evidence record must be nonempty after trimming and at most 500 characters long.

errors.name: MissingSummaryTextError
errors.description: A summary must supply its text as a string.

errors.name: UnsupportedRecordKindError
errors.description: The submitted value must use a supported report record kind.
